Average Cost for Pet Odor Removal

October 16, 2020

Pet accidents, spills, and food debris can cause serious stains and nasty odor when left untreated and cleaned in your carpets, floors, upholstery, and furniture. When these concerns are not resolved quickly, it can greatly damage the beauty and construction of your fabrics.

Consequently, hiring a professional cleaning service for their pet stain and odor removersis a cost-efficient solution, because the service fee is much cheaper than buying a new carpet or upholstery.

In line, we are going to discuss the approximate costs of this cleaning service and the essential factors influencing it. Without further delays, let’s find out.

What Are The Average Costs for Removing Pet Stains and Odor

The rate of availing professional service for pet stain eraserand odor removal depends on an array of variables which include the type of cleaning method used, the severity of the problem, the company, and more.

Nevertheless, we are going to simplify matters to make it easy for you. So far, the usual range for this service is between $500 to $1400 which falls for standard cleaning and foul odor removal protocols. Meanwhile, the next possible cheapest estimate is $100 to $800.

If we look into carpet pet odor eliminatorservice, the common price starts at $150 for one room. Then, there will be an added cost of $50 to $80 per furniture or upholstery to be included in the cleaning service.

Estimated Costs Per Cleaning or Service Type

Here, we are going to sub-divide the cost per type of cleaning method applied for your carpets, upholstery, furniture, and floors. As the rule of thumb, the more intricate the cleaning process, the higher will be its corresponding pet odor removal cost.

Moreover, if you want an odor removal process that uses zero chemicals, then its average cost range between $100 to $125 per hour. Below are the different processes for taking out those pet accidents and smell.

Soft Cleaning Methods

This light sanitation and odor removal method are suitable for small pet accidents or spills, which have not yet penetrated the bottom-layer of your carpets, rugs, and hardwood floors.

For carpet and rug basic cleaning service, the running price is $75 to $200 for a single room. If you want to avail of a pet pee stain removersolution, then there is an extra cost of $30 to $40 per hour. In line, the industry’s average for professional pet stain and odor removal serviceis between $100 to $125 per hour.

Mid-Range Cleaning and Deodorizing

If the severity of your pet accidents is worse and light scrubbing won’t work, then our crew will perform moderate sanitation and deodorization service on your carpets, rugs, upholstery, and floors.

We still use EPA-approved green cleaning products and disinfectants to preserve your fabrics and avoid leaving harmful residues after the process. Meanwhile, the average pet odor removal costfor this tier is $175 to $500.

Deep Cleaning Process

Meanwhile, removing those deep-seated stains and foul smell can cost expensively ranging from $800 to $1000. If it is your hardwood or flooring affected by these pet accidents, then ripping off the damaged area entails a cost of $50 to $100 per hour.

If the subfloor needs to be buffed or sanded, then there is an extra cost of $50 to $150 per hour. However, if the damage is extremely severe, then you need to replace your damaged floorings and it would cost $500 to $1000 depending on the material and area.

Extracting The Sub Floor

This process is applied for only small areas affected by your pet’s urine. For this method, we shall place an enzyme-derivative cleaning solution on the affected area of your carpet or rug. After, we are going to use a powerful suction tool that will aggressively suck the moisture and odor from your pet’s urine. In terms of cost, its running price is $50 to $200.

Carpet Steam Cleaning

We use a hot water extraction process that effectively removes 90% of dirt, stains, foul odor, and dust from your area rugs, carpets, and upholstered furniture. The main gripe or this process will be its longer drying time which can last for 24 hours.

The average price of carpet steam cleaning is between $100 to $200 for one room.

Ozone Disinfection Process

The principle of this method is straightforward, which is bombarding your room with ozone to naturally disinfect your place. Most pathogens, molds, and mildews can be killed by excess oxygen exposure.

When ozonating an area of 1,000 square feet or smaller the price is $300, while a 3,000 square feet costs around $1,100.

What are The Factors Affecting Cost of Pet Odor and Stain Removal

The rates for hiring a local cleaning company is influenced by many variables, and the locals are particular to it. To help you get a good concept about how the pricing works, here are the critical elements that affect the price of pet stain and foul odor removal services.

  • The area size affected by pet accidents and spills
  • How long has the stain stayed in your flooring, carpets, rugs, and upholstery?
  • The severity of stains and pet accidents
  • The type of cleaning method applied
  • Additional cleaning products and stain protectants

Other Considerations

Meanwhile, here are some additional things you need to consider when hiring a local cleaning service to remove those pet accidents and stinky smell from your flooring, carpets, and upholstery.

  • If the pet stains and smell have intensely penetrated your floor or carpets, it is best to treat your entire room for sanitation and deodorization.
  • Hire a cleaning service with a solid track record for handling pet accidents.
  • Do DIY stain and odor removal cleaning actions to reduce the severity of the problem before hiring a professional cleaner.
  • Always ask for a free estimate and what is included in the service

Causes For Nasty Stains and Foul Smell

The stubborn stains and stinky odor from your carpets, area rugs, and upholstered furniture greatly reduces aesthetics and function. If you leave this untreated for a couple of hours, the problem becomes more severe, so you need to address it promptly.

Further, here are some of the common culprits of these hard-to-remove stains and foul smell:

  • Pet Urine: Your dog or cat’s urine is the typical cause for the yellowish or orange stains and strong pungent smell in your carpets, rugs, and upholstery. When you see your pet urinating, it is best to blot the affected surface to prevent it from penetrating to the bottom surface.
  • Growth of Bacteria and Molds: The pungent and rotten smell you sense from stains and pet accidents are a sign that there is a growth of pathogens. In that case, deodorization and disinfection are needed.
  • Pet Allergies: If your pet has eaten something that is not compatible with their system, then they will exhibit allergic reactions which can lead to uncontrolled waste excretion.
  • Body Oils: The natural body oils produced in the skin of a person or animal stick to your carpets and upholstery which causes stained marks and pungent smell.
